records.before: ಅವನ ಆ ಮಾತನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ಮಹಾಸುರರೆಲ್ಲರೂ ಸಂತೋಷಗೊಂಡರು. ಕಾಲನನ್ನೂ ನಡುಗಿಸುವಂತಹ ಮೇಘಗರ್ಜನೆಗಳಿಂದ ಗರ್ಜಿಸಿದರು. ॥೧೯॥
records.source_reading: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा हृष्टाः सर्वे महासुराः । नदंतो मेघसन्नादैः कालानां कलनात्मकैः ॥१९॥
records.notes: Joy on hearing his words and cloud-like roaring are supported. The actual base confirms कालानां कलनात्मकैः, including plural कालानां. Kannada ಕಾಲನನ್ನೂ ನಡುಗಿಸುವಂತಹ remains a contextual interpretive gloss, not a literal resolution of that unusual compound. The scan settles letters but does not prove trembling or justify replacing the phrase with a conjectural literal paraphrase.

records.before: ಆ ಆನೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಹಾವೀರರು ಕುಳಿತಿದ್ದರು; ಅವು ಅಸ್ತ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದ್ದವು. ಚಲಿಸುವ ಪರ್ವತಗಳಂತೆ ಅವು ಶೋಭಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು. ॥೨೭॥
records.source_reading: महावीराश्रितान्येव कुंतलाद्यस्त्रकैस्तथा । पूर्णानि चंचलाश्चैव पर्वता इव शोभिताः ॥२७॥
records.notes: Original confirms कुंतलाद्यस्त्रकैः; there is an actual ल after त, not a clear warrant to silently print कुंताद्यस्त्रकैः. Elephants bearing great warriors, filled with weapons and resembling moving mountains are supported by25–29. Current generic weapons wording avoids an invented list or decorative-hair interpretation. Exact lexical resolution of कुंतलादि remains held; source gender shifts are preserved, not repaired.

records.before: ರಥಗಳು ಉತ್ತಮ ಮಣಿ, ಮುತ್ತು ಮೊದಲಾದವುಗಳಿಂದ ಅಲಂಕೃತವಾಗಿದ್ದವು. ಅವು ನಾನಾ ಶಸ್ತ್ರಾಸ್ತ್ರಗಳ ಭಾರದಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿ ಮೇಘಗಳಂತೆ ಘೋಷಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು. ॥೩೯॥
records.source_reading: रथाश्वालंकृतास्तत्र मणिमुक्तादिभिः परैः । नानाशस्त्रास्त्रभारैश्च पूरिता मेघघोषिणः ॥३९॥
records.notes: The original junction is visibly रथाश्वालंकृतास्तत्र, with श्व, not an independently established रथाश्चालंकृतास्तत्र. Current chariots-only rendering is plausible in38–41 but is not a complete resolution of this spelling. Do not insert horses solely from an uncertain compound analysis or silently emend श्व to श्च. Jewels/pearls, weapons and cloud-like sound are supported. Retain the subject/junction hold.

records.before: ಮತ್ಸರನ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯಿಂದ ಅವನು ಬೇಗನೆ ಮನುಷ್ಯರ ಹೃದಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಹಾರಮಾಡಿದನು. ಆ ಅಸ್ತ್ರಶಸ್ತ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ರೋಗಗಳು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪೀಡಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟವು. ॥೨೯॥
records.source_reading: मत्सरप्रेरणात् शीघ्रं नराणां हृद्यताडयत् । तेनास्त्रेण च शस्त्रेण रोगाः परमपीडिताः ॥२९॥
records.notes: Original clearly confirms नराणां हृद्यताडयत्. Current men’s-heart blow followed by diseases being severely afflicted follows those words; context28 supplies Vishayapriya as the preceding actor. The narrative transition amid personified Death/diseases remains unusual. Do not replace men with diseases or silently change the subject to repair narrative logic. A source-integrity/interpretive hold remains, despite supported literal wording.

records.before: ದೈತ್ಯಪುತ್ರನು ಬಂದು ತನ್ನ ಕತ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಐರಾವತ ಆನೆಯನ್ನು ಮೂರ್ಛೆಗೊಳಿಸಿದನು; ವಜ್ರಧಾರಿ ಇಂದ್ರನನ್ನು ಕಾಲಿನಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದನು. ॥೪೮॥
records.source_reading: दैत्यपुत्रः समागत्य खड्गेनैरावतं गजम् । मूर्छितं कारयामास वज्रिणं च पदाग्रहीत् ॥४८॥
records.notes: Original shows खड्गेनैरावतं, supporting the existing sword interpretation rather than the supplied historical स्वङ्गेन. Airavata is explicitly made unconscious; Indra is seized, and49 adds subduing/binding him. No Indra-unconsciousness claim is warranted. The visible पदाग्रहीत् remains compressed/grammatically uncertain as to the exact foot-related action; current ಕಾಲಿನಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದನು is retained provisionally, not certified as the only physical interpretation. No safe minimal replacement established.
